findings.description: The separator selection in get_help_spec is inverted relative to the original code. The original used "; " when any_prefix_is_slash was true and " / " otherwise. The new code uses "; " when the flag is false and " / " when it is true.
findings.rationale: Trigger: any option whose prefixes are rendered with slashes, such as a boolean flag "--shout/--no-shout" (any_prefix_is_slash is true), and any option without slash prefixes (flag false). For the slash case the joiner becomes " / " where it used to be "; ", and for the normal case it becomes "; " where it used to be " / ". Because get_help_record now returns get_help_spec(ctx), every help record's left column is affected. The help output shows the wrong separator for every option, which is a visible regression in the rendered --help text.
